async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Check for a search bar on the current page
    search_bar = None
    # Look for a searchbox role
    if await page.get_by_role("searchbox").count() > 0:
        search_bar = page.get_by_role("searchbox").first
    else:
        # Try textbox with name containing 'search'
        if await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="search", exact=False).count() > 0:
            search_bar = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="search", exact=False).first
    
    if not search_bar:
        # Step 2: Navigate to Sample Page to look for search bar
        sample_page_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Sample Page", exact=True)
        await sample_page_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")
        # Check for search bar on Sample Page
        if await page.get_by_role("searchbox").count() > 0:
            search_bar = page.get_by_role("searchbox").first
        elif await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="search", exact=False).count() > 0:
            search_bar = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="search", exact=False).first
        else:
            # If no search bar on Sample Page, return to homepage and assume it's there
            await page.goto("/")
            await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")
            if await page.get_by_role("searchbox").count() > 0:
                search_bar = page.get_by_role("searchbox").first
            elif await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="search", exact=False).count() > 0:
                search_bar = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="search", exact=False).first
    
    if not search_bar:
        raise Exception("Search bar not found on the site.")
    
    # Step 3: Fill search bar with 'DeepSeek' and trigger search
    await search_bar.fill("DeepSeek")
    # Try to submit by pressing Enter
    await search_bar.press("Enter")
    await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")
    # Alternatively, look for a search button and click
    search_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="search", exact=False)
    if await search_button.count() > 0:
        await search_button.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")
    
    # Step 4: Click the bottom result
    # Wait for search results to load
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    # Identify result items; assume they are links within a search results container
    results = []
    # Try to get all links on the page after search
    all_links = page.get_by_role("link")
    link_count = await all_links.count()
    if link_count > 0:
        # Store links as elements
        results = [all_links.nth(i) for i in range(link_count)]
    else:
        # Fallback to articles or other elements
        articles = page.get_by_role("article")
        article_count = await articles.count()
        if article_count > 0:
            results = [articles.nth(i) for i in range(article_count)]
        else:
            # Last resort: elements containing 'DeepSeek' text
            deepseek_elements = page.get_by_text("DeepSeek", exact=False)
            deepseek_count = await deepseek_elements.count()
            if deepseek_count > 0:
                results = [deepseek_elements.nth(i) for i in range(deepseek_count)]
    
    if len(results) == 0:
        raise Exception("No search results found for 'DeepSeek'.")
    
    # Click the bottom result (last in the list)
    bottom_result = results[-1]
    await bottom_result.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")
